tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /las sgrib sbyong ba'i thabs mchog rdo rje sems dpa'i bum sgrub bzhugs/

na mo badzra sa twa ye/ 'dir las sgrib dang sdig ltung sbyang ba'i thabs dam pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bum sgrub bshad pa la/ bum rdzas dang ldan pa'i bum pa mgul 'ching dkar po dang bcas pa sta gon byas la/ de'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams te/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdor sems su bskyed kyang rung la/ cung zad rgyas par na/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hūṃ yig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshul 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje dbyings kyis dbang phyug ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa gnyis ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i bu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gis lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī ye hūṃḥzhes gsungs shing*/ spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag

/chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog nas zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūṃ nas shapta āḥhūṃ gi bar gyis bla med ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ badzra sa twa arghaṃ pra titstsha nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod yod na ni 'bul rung*/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i zla gdan la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas thugs ka'i hūṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas gzi brjid dang mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsams la/ yig brgya brgya 'am nyer gcig bzla zhing mthar sngar bzhin mchod bstod bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa sngar ltar byin brlabs byas te/ bum pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las byung ba'i bum pa dkar po lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ bum pa'i nang du paṃ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūṃ yig dkar po nas yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po nas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin bya/ de nas mchod pa ni/

chu bo gaṅgā ma sogs ci rigs kyi mthar/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ sogs btags la mchod cing sngar bzhin bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad kyang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas thugs ka'i zla gdan la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros nas yon tan phun sum tshogs par gyur te sku yi cha nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsams la/ yig brgya brgya'am stong ngam khri sogs ci 'grub bzla/ de nas gtor ma sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i steng du yi ge gsum/ de las 'od zer 'phros rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa'i rdzas rnams zhu zhing 'khol rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams bkug nas yi ge gsum la thim pas de gsum yang rim gyis zhu nas thod par lhung bas sbyang rtogs sbar gsum byas pa'i zag med kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa pā ri wa ra i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun nam gsum gyis dbul zhing mchod bstod bya/ ma rnyes sogs kyis bzod gsol gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥbadzra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs shing*/ dam tshig pa bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i chu de rang gzhan gang gis kyang 'thung zhing khrus byas na'ang las sgrib sdig ltung dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang bar 'gyur bas dgos pa shin tu che ba'i phyir rang cag lta bus 'di la 'bad par bya'o/ /rdor sems kyi sgom bzlas byed par 'dod na/

sangs rgyas chos tshogs la lan gsum gyis skyabs sems byas nas/ spyir rdor sems bskyed tshul la/ rang rdor sems su bskyed pa dang*/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bskyed cing bzlas pa byed pa dang*/ gong du bshad pa ltar bya ba sogs du ma zhig yod pa rnams gang byas kyang mi 'gal zhing phun sum tshogs par 'gyur mod/ 'dir bla ma snga ma'i phyag len ltar rang gi spyi bor rdor sems bskyed chog mdzad pa bzhin byed par 'dod na/ rang tha mal pa'am/ lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas kyang rung la/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig dkar po de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhes pa nas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra sa twa sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ zhes pa nas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur ces pa'i bar gong bzhin bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa nas/ mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs par gyur ces pa'i bar gyi gsol ba gdab cing*/ yig brgya nyer gcig gam ci 'grub bzla'o/ /yi ge brgya pa'i grangs ni srog ldan gyi yi ge dbang du byas kyi gzhan pa rgya las mang zhing*/ oṃ dang hūṃ phaṭa rnams ni der ma gtogs so/ / mthar bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /zhes pa nas sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur pa bsam mo/ /'di la stobs bzhi tshang tshul ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnyis rten gyi stobs/ yig brgya'i bzlas pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ bdag ni mi shes sogs ni sun 'byin pa'i stobs yin la/

de'i shugs la slar ldog pa'i stobs bstan to/ /yi ge brgya pa'i sngags don ni/ oṃ ni sku rdo rje'i sa bon yin zhing*/ mchog nor bkra shis sogs don bdun la 'jug /badzra sa twa ni rdo rje sems dpa'/ sa ma ya ni dam tshig /ma nu pā la ya ni rjes su skyongs/ badzra sa twa twe no pa ni rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyis nye bar/ tiṣṭha ni gnas pa/ ḍi ḍho ni brtan pa/ me ni bdag /bha wa ni dngos po'am rang bzhin du mdzod/ su to ṣyo ni shin tu dgyes pa/ su po ṣyo ni shin tu rgyas pa/ a nu rakto ni rjes su chags pa/ me bha wa gsum ni sngar bzhin no/ /sarba siddhi ni dngos grub thams cad/ me pra yatstsha ni bdag la stsol bar mdzod/ sarba karma su tsa me ni bdag la las thams cad rtsol bar mdzod/ tsittaṃ shrī yaḥku ru ni sems sam snying gi dpal du mdzod/ hūṃ ni thugs kyi sa bon dang*/ ha bzhi dang ho dang lngas ni ye shes lnga mtshon/ bha ga wan ni bcom ldan 'das/ sarba ta thā ga ta ni de bzhin gshes pa thams cad kyi/ badzra ma me ni rdo rje bdag /muñtsa ni ma 'dor cig /badzri bha wa ni rdo rje can gyi rang bzhin du/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa ni dam tshig chen po'i sems dpa'/ āḥni gsung dang*/ hūṃ ni thugs kyi sa bon/ phaṭa ni gsal bar byed pa 'am 'joms par byed pa'o/ /yi ge brgya pa tshul bzhin du bzlas na/ sdig ltung thams cad sbyong zhing 'phel kha gcod pa dang dam tshig nyams pa sbyong ba'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ snying po rgyan las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gcig po/ /pad dkar zla ba'i dbus gnas shing*/ /rdo rje dril bu rgyan spras pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs dmigs shing*/ /yi ge brgya ba cho ga bzhin/ /nyi shu rtsa ni re re bzlas/ /ltung sogs byin gyis brlob 'gyur pas/ /'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes/ /grub pa mchog rnams kyi bshad pa/ / thun mtshams su ni spyad par bya/

/'bum phrag tu ni bzlas gyur na/ /rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di'i dmigs skor byed tshul la mang ste/ /rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ yig gi thig le'i nang du zla gdan gyi dbus su rang dang mthar pha ma sogs sems can thams cad kyis bskor bar dmigs nas/ rang gi spyi bo'i rdor sems yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs te rang dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i dmigs pa dang*/ yang rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i zla gdan gyi dbus su rang dang mthar sems can thams cad 'khor bar mos nas sngar bzhin 'bebs sbyang byed pa dang*/ yang rang lhar gsal ba'i mdun du dbus su rang dang mthar sems can 'khod pa'am/ yang rang tha mal du gnas pa'i mdun nas brtsams te pha ma la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyis bskor bar bsams nas/ rang gi spyi bo'i rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka'i hūṃ yig las rdor sems yab yum dpag tu med pa sems can thams cad kyi grangs dang mnyam pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi spyi bor rdor sems yab yum zung re re bzhugs par gyur nas rang dang sems can thams cad kyis yig brgya 'don par bsam zhing*/ rang dang sems can so so'i spyi bo nas bzhugs pa'i rdor sems yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun na ra na ra byung ste/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi spyi bo nas zhugs pas sdig ltung thams cad sol khu dang dud khu'i rnam par dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas phyir 'thon te sdig sgrib thams cad dag par mos pa'i tshul rnams las/ phyi ma ltar byas na bde bar sems so/ /mthar rdor sems rang la bstim nas dbyer med du gyur par bsams te/ slar yang yig brgya re gnyis sogs gang 'grub dang*/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūṃ zhes pa rdor sems kyi snying po ci 'grub re bzlas na ni khyad che/

de nas dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas/ /zhes sogs brjod cing*/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na sngar ltar bya'o/ /ces pa 'di ni dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i gnas brtan rgyal mtshan bkra shis zhes bgyi ba rang nyid kyi dad pas kun nas bslangs te par du brko bar bya'o zhes bskul ba'i don du shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis gzhan 'ga' re la phan srid snyam du bsams nas sbyar ba'o/ /sarba siddhi mme pra yatstshantu/ maṃ ga laṃ kurwantu/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/las sgrib sbyong ba'i thabs mchog rdo rje sems dpa'i bum sgrub bzhugs/ -PAGE 250--PAGE 251--PAGE 248-
